suggestions.title: Compare score across tier groups
suggestions.explanation: Warnings: Group(s) 'upper', 'low' have fewer than 30 values. Welch's t-test assumes approximately normal group means, so check those groups for skew or outliers. Welch's independent-samples t-test compares the mean of score across the groups defined by tier. Observed mean score: upper 31.54 (median 31.50, n=24), low 21.75 (median 21.50, n=12). The test gave t = 11.00 with 32.74 degrees of freedom. The p-value (1.56e-12) is below 0.05, so the data show evidence of a difference in means between groups. The group means are 3.01 pooled standard deviations apart (Cohen's d), a large gap by Cohen's benchmarks. The size label describes magnitude in this dataset, not practical importance or cause.
